Name: Genevieve Barton
Core Memory 1: School trip with year 11 students to Northern Italy. She had never felt so connected to her students. The laughs and tears changed her feelings about wanting to become a parent.
Core Memory 2: Before moving in with Zachary, she received a DM from an old flame from her college days. She met Pete for dinner and realised… that Zachary really was The One after all!
Core Memory 2 Summary: Finally convinced that Zachary is The One.
Core Memory 3: During teacher training, she lied about her parents income on her Student Loan application to get a lower interest rate. She spent three years in absolute terror and has been super honest ever since.
Core Memory 3 Summary: Lied to get a cheaper Student Loan
Secondary Memory 1: Playing the lead in her local am-dram production of As You Like It. She’s finally memorised all of the lines
Secondary Memory 1 Summary: Her script for As You Like It
Secondary Memory 2:
Heartbroken that she shouted at her cat the morning that he disappeared.
It was last year.
Secondary Memory 3: Hasn't told her boyfriend about the parking ticket last month in case he thinks she is stupid.
Secondary Memory 4: Went on the TV gameshow, "Pointless" but argued with her friend after he scored 200.
Secondary Memory 5: Has just bought a new scarf for the winter. It's the warmest and most comforting thing she owns and can't be without it.

Name: Yelena Desjardins
Core Memory 1: The development of five hundred homes on the Northfield estates is under threat because Connection Machines want to build a data centre instead. The go/nogo meeting is on Monday and she has the smoking gun about bribes being made by CM.
Core Memory 1 Summary: She can stop the Connection Machines data centre.
Core Memory 2: She built a dollhouse with her daughter. It was the most perfect day in her life. Her daughter has taken it with her to University.
Core Memory 2 Summary: Built a dollhouse with her daughter.
Core Memory 3: Lying in my bed I hear the clock tick and think of you. Caught up in circles, confusion is nothing new. Flashback, warm nights, almost left behind. Suitcase of memories, Time after…
Core Memory 3 Summary: The lyrics to Cyndi Lauper’s “Time After Time”
Secondary Memory 1: It took almost three years to do this, but Yelena has finally memorised the layout of all three local authority buildings. She hates getting lost.
Secondary Memory 1 Summary: Knows her way around in work!
Secondary Memory 2: November is the right time to plant more daffodils. She’s failed for the last three years but this time will be different!
Secondary Memory 3: Decided it was time to stay out of her mother’s way for a few months. Forty Two years of being judged is more than enough. Christmas without arguments will be a joy!
Secondary Memory 4: The local development committee is full of lunatics and never get anything done. Forget it! I’m out. (Sorry Hot Buns! You’re on your own.)
Secondary Memory 4 Summary: Leaving the local development committee - tell Hot Buns.
Secondary Memory 5: The brown dress looked great on the rack but makes her look like a sausage. Take. It. Back. Before. Saturday.

Name: Hot Buns

Core Memory 2: My Recipe book! Ten years of ideas, way too much to remember everything so the whole lot is in this folder. Super precious. Do not DELETE FFS!
Core Memory 3: Local development grant available. I need to apply for this, my friend Yelena is on the committee and thinks I will be a guaranteed winner!
Core Memory 3 Summary: Apply for the local development grant!
Secondary Memory 1: The rent on the shop is overdue. The November invoice needs to be paid by Wednesday.
Secondary Memory 2: The lighting in the shop feels like an interrogation chamber. The electrictian is coming to refit everything on Thursday 18th.
Secondary Memory 3: Special offer of flour from Mill Time Bakery Wholesalers! Orders only open for 12 hours on Monday.
Secondary Memory 4: Bake-Off audition email chain. One last step and I'm on the show! Awaiting the next appointment.
Secondary Memory 5: New sign PDF! The printers still have the old logo for the shop. Get them the new artwork or the new sign will be shit.
